text.en:
The Name of the Municipality - There shall be created the Municipality of Ponot, Province of
Zamboanga del Norte, out of the southwestern barangays of the Municipality of Manukan, Zamboanga del
Norte, namely: Ponot, Manawan, Dinasan, Tamil, Tabon, Lopero and Madalag. The seat of the Municipal
Government shall be in Barangay Ponot.

The Technical Description of the Municipal Territory - The technical description of the
territorial jurisdiction of the Municipality of Ponot shall be, beginning from the mouth of Disakan River;
thence following Disakan River upstream until it intersects latitude eight degrees and twenty-two minutes
8°22’); thence due east until it reaches Dohinob Dacu River; thence following Dohinob Dacu River upstream
until it intersects longitude one hundred twenty-three degrees and ten minutes (123°10’); thence due south
until it intersects latitude eight degrees and seventeen minutes 8°17’); thence due west until it intersects
longitude one hundred twenty-three degrees and four minutes 123° 04’); thence running in straight line on a
northwestern direction following the existing municipal boundary between the Municipalities of Manukan and
Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, until it reaches the shoreline; thence following the shoreline on
a northeastern direction until it reaches the mouth of Disakan River, the point of beginning. (Technical
description is part of the record.)

The Municipal Government Officials, their qualifications and salaries - The qualifications
salaries, compensation or emoluments of the municipal government officials of Ponot shall be those provided
for and fixed by existing law.

Appointment of Municipal Government Officials - After ratification by the majority of the votes
cast in plebiscite to be conducted in the area or areas affected within a period of ninety days after the approval
of this Act, the President (Prime Minister) shall appoint the Mayor and other officials of the new Municipality

Effectivity - This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: January 3, 1979
